发送内容：当你主动使用 AI 功能时，应用可能发送你的提示词、当前文章与站点上下.en: Data sent: When you actively use AI features, the app may send your prompts, the current article and site context, knowledge-base excerpts you have allowed to be sent, and images you add. The provider handles this content under its privacy policy.
